name: Port Test
author: heffneil
description: Tick the pixel-string ports of a controller and light only those, using the same test patterns as FPP's Testing menu (Port Number, Pixel Count, the fades) so you can see which props are on which port. Handy when ports are not yet assigned in xLights. The test stays lit until you turn it off.

privacy.summary: Lights chosen pixel ports with test patterns. Nothing is sent anywhere. A small temporary test file sits in this device's sequences folder while a test is lit, and Off deletes it.
privacy.other: Starts and stops test patterns through FPP's own local API: a temporary effect file named porttest_*.fseq is written to the sequences folder and deleted when the test is turned off, and FPP's channel test is used for Solid, Chase and Cycle. Uninstalling stops any test this plugin left running and deletes its test files.
